IC1: Males [OR] or non-pregnant, non-nursing females between the ages of 2-65 years
IC2: LTBI  diagnosis [AND] as per Canadian TB Standards using either the Tuberculin Skin Test (TST) [OR] or the Interferon Gamma Release Assay (IGRA)
IC3: Children 2-5 years with negative TSTs who have been in close contact with a case of active TB disease recently
IC4: Able and willing to provide fully informed consent or parent/guardian able to provide consent
